name: Agent Sherine
source:
Sherine Hale, an undercover CIA operative, is assigned a high-stakes mission involving a wealthy Russian oligarch. Tasked with infiltrating his life and installing spy software on his home network, Sherine is thrust into dangerous situations and forced to navigate complicated situations. The stakes are high, involving the oil business and massive sums of money. Relying on her sharp mind, deductive skills, and charm, Sherine maneuvers through tense encounters with different people involved into oil business. Players will guide her decisions, shaping how she walks the fine line between success and failure.

The decisions players make will shape the outcome of her story and her survival.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/arctic_studio/about]Patreon[/url]]
